sample.design: stratified by the 9 official categories, proportional allocation by largest remainder (ties broken by category name); within each category a seeded permutation, the first n_c questions are taken

price_source: research/paper_benchmark_common.py MODEL_PRICES_USD_PER_M, snapshot dated 2026-09-12; the pages cited for it in research/PAPER_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md are https://openrouter.ai/openai/gpt-4.1-mini/pricing and https://openrouter.ai/google/gemini-3-flash-preview/pricing. Not re-verified for this run.
fee_factor_source: FEE_FACTOR in research/final_sprint_evermembench.py: a conservative margin applied on top of list token prices in the previous paid runs; not a published OpenRouter per-token markup
cost_basis: actual usage.prompt_tokens and usage.completion_tokens returned by the API, times the prices above, times fee_factor; every judge attempt is counted
output_estimate: mean completion tokens of paid calls in the sealed runs, per condition and question type for answers; pooled over sealed judge calls (keys prefixed 'judge:') for the judge, times mean paid attempts per judged row
